Summary
Hello, my name is Rananda Ardiawan, a Computer Science student
majoring in Informatics Engineering at the Faculty of Computer
Science, Brawijaya University. Since childhood, I have had a strong
interest in technology and programming logic. This has driven me to
choose the Informatics Engineering major as a path to develop my
interests and talents.
During my studies, I have been actively involved in various activities
related to software development. I have attended several trainings
and workshops on web and mobile application development using
frameworks such as React, Angular, and Flutter. Additionally, I
am also interested in the DevOps field and have learned tools like
Docker, Kubernetes, and Jenkins to assist in the integration and
deployment of applications.
Seeing the rapid technological developments, I believe that the
future will be dominated by professions related to information
technology. Therefore, my career goal is to become a skilled
DevOps Engineer and Full Stack Developer. I want to contribute
to building innovative applications that provide solutions for the
community.
To realize this career goal, I continue to strive to improve my abilities
and knowledge in the field of technology. I actively participate in
various programming competitions and hackathons to test and
sharpen my skills. In addition, I also regularly learn about the latest
technologies through online tutorials, articles, and reference books.
With a strong educational background, relevant interests, and
unwavering determination, I am confident that I can become a
professional DevOps Engineer and Full Stack Developer and
contribute to the advancement of information technology in the

future. I am ready to continue learning, working, and giving my best
to the information technology industry in Indonesia.
